scope: Research only for a later URL/menu implementation phase. No routes, website source content, deployment or domain settings were changed.

preservationRequirement.userIntent: Serve the original citybond.in content at its existing public URLs. A redirect to a renamed or broader page is not the same as preserving that original URL.
preservationRequirement.recommendedPrimaryPolicy: Original public paths return 200 with their corresponding substantive content and self-referencing canonical URLs; new route aliases can redirect to original canonical paths if retained.
preservationRequirement.domain: Production should retain citybond.in when the domain migration is authorized. The current Vercel preview domain is not a replacement canonical domain merely because it hosts the implementation.
preservationRequirement.coverageLimit: 179 discovered URLs are an audit inventory, not a guarantee of all indexed URLs. Include original CMS exports, all sitemaps, Search Console, access logs, media/downloads and URL variants before claiming complete preservation.

baselineSummary.anomaly: The /index record has HTTP200 in both raw audit and final workbook, while handling is Missing redirect. A200 response alone is not proof of equivalent content or preserved canonical URL. Current routing source lacks explicit /index support; recheck body/canonical in subsequent implementation.

gaps.finding: All 14 audited product paths redirect to /products/{slug}; original paths are not canonical direct pages.
gaps.requiredLater: Render each original product path directly and keep its metadata and relevant surface/specification content.

gaps.finding: These distinct pages currently redirect to the generic /products page.
gaps.requiredLater: Restore dedicated, editable pages matching each original topic.

gaps.finding: These pages redirect to /projects, losing the individual application topic.
gaps.requiredLater: Restore dedicated application pages and link related product/project content.

gaps.finding: Original company, founder, awards, service and resource paths mostly redirect to renamed or merged routes.
17 original city URLs redirect to /network; /vijyawada is 404 because the code derives the differently spelled vijayawada alias.
gaps.requiredLater: Restore all 18 original regional pages with real source-backed regional content; retain the original vijyawada spelling in the URL.

gaps.finding: The /blog index redirects to /resources. The audit includes 68 article URLs, 12 category URLs, 21 Web Story URLs, nine pagination URLs and a story index; these content families are largely absent. Even the three imported articles have no working original /blog/{slug}/ path.
gaps.requiredLater: Import or retain the existing blog and stories system at its original paths, including category, pagination, article and story URLs; do not replace these with generic index redirects.

gaps.finding: The inventory includes /contact.php, /hpl-series, /index, /sitemap.html and three already-broken original URLs.
gaps.requiredLater: Verify original response/body/canonical for aliases, restore the HTML sitemap as HTML, and handle truly replaced aliases with explicit one-to-one permanent redirects only where appropriate.

gaps.finding: Current metadataBase, sitemap and robots sitemap URL hardcode citybond-studio.vercel.app; the route metadata code does not set per-page canonical URLs.
gaps.requiredLater: Set the authorized production origin consistently; publish original-path canonicals, sitemap entries, internal links and structured metadata. Preserve noindex protections for portal/API/preview.

gaps.finding: The 179-page inventory excludes a complete legacy asset URL map; current curated assets use new /citybond/*.webp paths.
gaps.requiredLater: Inventory old image/PDF/video addresses and retain or permanently map them individually. Preserve existing download destinations and links.

recommendedLaterSequence: Freeze this phase to the requested brand/PDF changes; use this research as implementation input later.
Build one explicit canonical route manifest from the full original URL inventory, separating content pages, intentional aliases, anchor targets, pagination and media.

Make original URLs primary for existing content. Reuse components and CMS records without redirecting away from old canonical addresses. Add missing application, thickness, core, city, founder, award and editorial records.

Implement editable desktop dropdown/mega menus and mobile accordions using the original groups and exact destination paths. Support keyboard activation, Escape, visible focus, touch and reduced motion.
Point modern route aliases to the restored original canonicals where needed; use one-hop permanent redirects for approved URL changes, not blanket redirects to broad index pages.
Generate internal links, canonicals and XML/HTML sitemaps from the same manifest and production origin.
Run a full crawl and compare every original URL: response, redirect chain, title, canonical, heading, content identity, images, anchors, structured data and mobile menu reachability.
At authorized production cutover, retain host/domain configuration, verify Search Console and monitor indexing/404s; do not claim preservation solely from the new preview site working.
